The decisive error occurred when the Planner failed to synthesize this retrieved evidence into the final conclusion, instead hallucinating that Childers was the non-English candidate and misidentifying Henry Roth as the English one.

However, instead of synthesizing this correctly to conclude Childers is the English writer, the Planner hallucinated a contradictory fact (that Childers was Irish-born/London but then mislabeled Childers as the non-English candidate while incorrectly asserting Henry Roth was English). This failure to map the retrieved facts (Childers=London/English) to the task conclusion (Who is from England?) is the decisive error.
